name: How the Saying Goes
source:
The love I have for you burns brighter than any flame.

The passion I feel for you is stronger than any army.

I need you the way I need air. Like the sun needs the moon. 

You will be mine. ‘Till death do us part…

… That’s how the saying goes, right?

[From [url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/how-the-saying-goes]itch.io[/url]]
